Original body:

Keep actual usage accounting; stop for a real provider limit/refusal or explicit user stop only; never evade provider limits. Continue the existing MVP-05 C2 with preserved partial changes/evidence, same logical task and frozen F01-F04 + AC001..007 scope; retain prior actual usage 12,318,058 at call6 stop, including 1,155,000 on call6 vs former 900,000 (no refund/reset). Continue implementation and then the previously required final independent Codex review; remove obsolete token cap/reserve gates from project TASK/STATE/APPROVALS as appropriate, preserving review-cycle limits and all history. User authorization is current; no extra permission gate for this continuation. No push/deploy. Local commit only after routed PASS per existing permission. I previously attempted a decision_gate with stale dispatch ID and Orca rejected worker_identity_changed; this message intentionally has no worker/task dispatch identity and is addressed only to the owning Run coordinator.
